cases.name: Z Mega speed tie in Trick Room

assumptions: Choice Scarf is derived from the held `item` (or the `scarf` flag); Tailwind, paralysis, and weather-speed abilities are taken from the provided flags.
Speed modifiers apply in order: stage -> speed_mult(ability) -> Choice Scarf -> Tailwind -> paralysis, flooring after each.
Equal final Speed is reported as a tie (the engine breaks it randomly).
